source.title: Introducing Hounded: Crafting the dog adventure coming to PS5 in 2027
source.evidenceText: November 17, 2026November 17, 2026 Introducing Hounded: Crafting the dog adventure coming to PS5 in 2027 13 0 107 Like this Imprnt Studios founders share insights on how to craft the perfect dog protagonist. Julia Galus Marketing Specialist, Silver Lining Interactive Hey PlayStation community! We’ve been keeping a secret under wraps at Imprnt Studios and Silver Lining Interactive, and we can finally let the dog out of the bag: Hounded is heading to PS5 in 2027. Get ready to step into the paws of a brave (and incredibly adorable) Border Collie, Duke, as you help him search for his lost master in an epic journey across the conflict-torn world of Anglodia. Hounded has been in development for just over two years, and in that time we’ve been hard at work developing our very own Motion Matching system for our main character. Along with this exciting announcement, we wanted to show you what making our passion project actually looks like behind the scenes. So, we put together our very first dev diary with a full look into how the sausage (or kibble?) gets made. Have you ever wondered how you make a dog communicate through animation? Or what a realistic quadruped animation made from scratch looks like before it lands on your screen? We’re tackling all of that and more, while introducing the little guy who started this entire journey: Duke. Check it out. Play Video A dog story – who is Duke? Duke is a young, clumsy, yet loyal Border Collie. He lives in the world of Anglodia – a flintlock fantasy inspired Britain in the late 18th century. It is a beautiful and mythical land filled with mysterious technology that is coming apart at the seams under tyrannical rule. However, Duke’s interests lie outside of politics and the brewing rebellion against the crown… His master, Artemys Fletcher – a secretive key player in the resistance, has vanished. Duke’s home has been torn apart by the regime and the only thing that matters now is finding his master. Building a border collie from the paws up Here’s the thing about four-legged protagonists: you can’t just reskin a two-legged skeleton and call it a day. In our earliest test builds, Duke moved like a clunky wooden table with paws. It felt terrible—Border Collies have this iconic, low-slung energy that looks like they are about to run at all times. To bring this into reality in Unreal Engine, we decided to animate all of Duke’s movement by hand, using a handcrafted Motion Matching system. Eventually, we were able to set it up so that it pulls from a library of animations based on real-world references, selects the most appropriate animation for the movement, and smooths out the whole process (for the dev team and for the players). What does the dog say? Giving Duke a good expressive range has easily been one of the biggest creative mountains our narrative and animation teams had to climb. While humans rely on words, smirks, and raised eyebrows, Duke has muzzle twitches, ear pivots, and whiskers. We spent a while studying canine expressions and famous animated dogs (shout out to Dug) to make sure Duke could hold his own in cinematic story moments. Every movement, every sad face, and every happy snout you will see in the game is handcrafted by our incredible animation team. More than just a good boy – Magic of The Tide As adorable as he looks, Duke is far from an ordinary dog. Beneath the soil of Anglodia hums an ancient, strange magic known as The Tide, and Duke is one of its wielders. He possesses unlockable abilities that no other hound has, such as the Power Bark (smash through obstacles in your way) and Power Howl (electrically charge the mysterious technology you find in the world). He can even pierce the veil to perceive ghostly echoes trapped in time, known as Imprints, reliving moments that unfolded hours before he arrived. What will he discover, and will it help him find Fletcher? Wishlist on PS5 today Seeing our game come to life on PlayStation 5 is a dream come true for the whole team—you can add it to your wishlist on your console today. We’ve still got miles to run before 2027, but we wanted to put Duke on your radar early. Take the dev diary for a walk, tell us what you think of Duke, and give your own pets a solid scratch behind the ears from everyone on the crew today. HoundedImprnt Studios Did you like this?
